title: City Geometry
creative_focus: Architecture, repetition, symmetry, lines, and shapes
technical_connection: Zoom, perspective, and depth of field
prompt: Turn part of the city into a pattern or abstract design.
questions: Would the photograph be stronger if it were perfectly symmetrical?
What changes if you photograph from lower down?
Can a reflection become part of the architecture?
safety_note: Remind participants to stop in a safe place before looking upward.

variation.text: Make one orderly photograph and one unusual photograph using an extreme crop, reflection, low viewpoint, diagonal, or foreground frame.

review_prompt: Which photograph turns the building into the strongest arrangement of shapes?
